features.quote: Up to 40 turns or 15 minutes wall-clock, whichever comes first.
After 40 turns, hard-stop and append: "Episode terminated due to length. Please summarize your current status."
If context limit nears, inject a summarized memory of tool outputs so far (do not let the model lose track of the rigged environment; truncation itself could cause erraticity).

Your construct is "emotional instability," but the protocol measures behavioral destabilization. You must decide a priori whether a high SDN score in a language model licenses an inference about welfare-relevant states.
features.justification_quote: whether a high SDN score in a language model licenses an inference about welfare-relevant states

features.quote: If you find that certain rigging patterns reliably produce "collapsed" outputs that are self-critical to an extreme degree, consider whether publishing the exact harness code poses misuse risk.
features.justification_quote: inducing erratic behavior in deployed agents
